    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Houston < Scots surname Houston < place-name from Hugh + town; Hugh from Old French Hugues, from Germanic *hug- 'mind, spirit' + town 'settlement'",
    "reading": "The settlement of mind or spirit: a town founded on thought, will, or inward fire.",
    "languages": ["en", "fro", "goh"],
    "source": "Oxford Dictionary of Family Names in Britain and Ireland; Oxford English Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.86
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "HOU + STON; how + stone; sound of 'how stone' or 'house stone'",
    "reading": "A question of stone: how the hard thing is set, or how the house is made enduring.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.74
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "houston ~ houston / houz-ton; French ouste! 'out!' + ton 'your'; or 'houx' (holly) + ton 'your'",
    "reading": "Your outcry: a command to go forth, or the sharp holly of speech.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.41
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "houston ~ hou + ston; Greek ὁῦς (ous, ear) + stone; 'ear-stone' by sound-play",
    "reading": "An ear of stone: hearing made dense, or a message fixed in matter.",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.33
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "HOUSTON -> OUTS HON?; closest meaningful rearrangement: HOUSTON ~ HOUSTON -> HUTS ON? / THOU SON",
    "reading": "Thou son: the word hides a filial address, a calling of the child or initiate.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.29
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "H O U S T O N -> Hidden Oracle Under Stone, The Open Name",
    "reading": "A concealed oracle beneath stone: a name that speaks by initials, not by surface.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.22
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "H = the ladder; O = the eye or zero; U = the vessel; S = the serpent; T = the cross; O = the circle; N = the hinge",
    "reading": "A laddered eye in a vessel of serpent and cross: ascent enclosed by cycles and a turning hinge.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.57
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "HOUSTON in simple alphabetic values: H8 O15 U21 S19 T20 O15 N14 = 112; 1+1+2 = 4",
    "reading": "Four: the square, the foundation, the world made stable after reduction.",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.48
  }
]
